• Packstruct The shared /packs spec and its zero-dependency lint CLI; one manifest, entry, and lifecycle contract.
  • Crashtest Adversarial in-process QA: seeded campaigns whose verdicts refuse new exploits by name.
  • Eyestruct Deterministic look and diff over the rendered surface, with committed visual memory in labs/.eyes/.
  • Poststruct Audit over what actually shipped: baked HTML, links, i18n, and feeds, plus the family voice module.
  • Monoforge The stamp: new, cut, doctor, and lock, so a repo is born from proven blocks with its truth slots filled.
  • Coreforge The site rig: one config file, four verbs, two surfaces, zero hand-editing of brand data.
  • Gistory The prompt keeper and the prototype factory: staging trees plus the ferry that lands proven blocks.
  • Railyard The composer and the real factory: declares the suite, holds the mount registry, dispatches work across it.
  • Prestruct Build-time prerendering and structured-data injection: one index.html per route, one sitemap.
  • Freestruct The after-build SEO layer: runs and injects over the baked output, basePath aware.
  • Vant The agent OS that remembers its own work: a git-backed brain served over MCP, governed like any member.
  • Migrare A migration tool, parked: the work is on hold and the rebrand is deferred, so it stays a status, not a removal.
  • Stegoframe A steganography frame for carrying payloads inside images.
  • Audithole A hole to drop an audit through: inspect what a build actually shipped.
  • Threadforge A thread shaping tool, in beta, with a private repository.
  • Weisync A sync product running on its own domain, with a private repository.
  • Regarded A product on the backburner, living as a repository until the owner revives it.
  • This A repository-only product, live but not yet a site.
  • Vibe Flow Festival A festival site, shipped on its own domain.
  • Creadev.org The shop and the home site: the reference deployment every other member is proven against.
  • Creadev Security A published security library carved from a product.
  • Creadev QoS A published quality-of-service library carved from a product.
